schema.conditions: [{order,name,field,offset,extraFields[],slot f0..f9 | damageArray[..],formula,condition,appliesTo hit|dot|both,sources[],confidence}] in code order of CharacterMutator.ApplyConditionalDefenses
schema.slots: f0 damage multiplier, f1 extra block chance, f2 armour increase (armour*(1+f2)), f3/f4 endurance threshold additions, f5 crit avoidance addition, f6 parry (always 0), f7 delayed fraction, f8 extra endurance, f9 thorns increase
schema.leech: leech accrual, scale and gain-on-hit mechanics

convertDamageTaken.function: ProtectionClass.ConvertDamageTaken(DamageStats) @0x181124B30; called from ProtectionClass.ApplyDamage @0x181120140 only when ProtectionClass.hasDamageTakenConversion (0x176) is true
convertDamageTaken.flagSetter: ProtectionClass.updateHasDamageTakenAndLeechBools(Stats) @0x181128DA0 sets 0x176 if ANY Stat of SP 31..37 exists in Actor.stats.stats (also 0x177 for SP6 DamageTaken, 0x178 for SP51 HealthLeech, 0x179 for SP129 ability retaliation)
convertDamageTaken.formula: out = copy(damageArray_in[7]) ; for each Stat s in Actor.stats(BaseStats).stats (raw List<Stat>, list order) with s.property in SP31..SP37 (target type t = SP-31, array order Phys,Fire,Cold,Light,Necro,Void,Poison): pick the FIRST source type i in the fixed order Phys(AT 1), Lightning(AT 2), Cold(AT 4), Fire(AT 8), Void(AT 16), Necrotic(AT 32), Poison(AT 64) such that (s.tags & bit_i) != 0 AND damage_in[i] != 0; then m = min(s.addedValue, 1.0) * damage_in[i]; out[t] += m; out[i] -= m. Afterwards ApplyDamage multiplies every out[k] by (1 + damageModifier) (param_5).

details.tagMeaning: stat.tags is the SOURCE damage type (the type being converted), SP is the TARGET: DamageTakenAsFire + tags=Physical = "Physical damage taken as Fire". Confirmed by affix/unique data (e.g. "Fire Damage Taken As Physical" = SP31 + tags Fire).
details.valueUsed: Stat.addedValue (+0x1C) only; increased (+0x20), moreValues, specialTag and extraTag are ignored. Entries with the same (SP,tags,specialTag,extraTag) are collapsed by BaseStats.addStat (sum of added), so the 1.0 cap acts on the sum per (SP,tags) key.
details.normalisation: none. Each stat is clamped to <=1.0 individually but several stats from the same source are not normalised: shares can exceed 100% in total (source goes negative, negative entries are skipped by the per-type `M*damage[i] > 0` test of ApplyDamage so the extra shares become extra damage).
details.noChaining: every stat reads the ORIGINAL damage array (param DamageStats.damage), never the partially converted one; A->B and B->C do not chain.
details.negativeValues: not clamped below: a negative added value moves damage the other way.
details.whichDamage: all 7 types, hits and DoT alike (no isHit/DoT condition).
details.inertTags: only AT bits 1,2,4,8,16,32,64 are tested. Stats whose tags carry no damage-type bit never convert anything: KnightTree "Abyssal Fluctuation" (kn-1 id 64, SP36 DamageTakenAsVoid, tags=Elemental 0x80) and AcolyteTree "Decaying Form" (ac-1, >=6 pts, SP37 DamageTakenAsPoison, tags=DoT 0x1000, value 0.5) are therefore inert in this code (D). SP31-37 have no other reader in the dll (grep of all Stats.Get* call sites). Whether the game ships these nodes as bugs cannot be seen from code.
details.tagsUsedForStatQuery: none: this function scans the stat list directly (no Stats.GetStatValue call, no tag filter, no hitEvents).
details.orderInApplyDamage: (1) ConvertDamageTaken or plain copy, times (1+damageModifier); (2) DamageConditionalEffect.apply of attacker and ability; (3) IDefensiveConditionalProvider.ApplyConditionalDefenses(damageStats, damageArray, attacker, attackerExists) which may still scale damageArray entries (resistance-above-cap conditions); (4) per-type resist/penetration, then DamageTaken stat query with the CONVERTED type tag (tags = (otherTags & ~0xFF) | typeTag(i)), etc. So conversion happens before resistances: converted damage is mitigated by the resistance of the NEW type, and DamageTaken(type) mods of the new type apply.
details.sources: affixes (idol/sentinel suffixes: Idol X Damage Taken As Physical 2-3%, Sentinel Void/Poison Taken As Physical 18-19%, Idol Sentinel Cold/Fire ... 8-20%), uniques (The Ashen Crown phys->fire 40-80%, Orians Eye void->fire 100%, Bane of Winter cold->phys 100%, Blossom of Immortal Stone necro/poison/void->phys 100%, Ravenous Void phys->void 10-15%), Sabertooth skill node Shatterhide (SP33 cold, tags Physical, 1.0)

tests.desc: 40% physical taken as fire (affix/unique style: SP32 DamageTakenAsFire, tags=Physical)
share >100% is clamped per stat to 1.0
two stats of 60% from the same source type are NOT normalised: phys goes negative (skipped later because M*damage[i] > 0 test fails), total of positive entries = 120%
no chaining: stats use the ORIGINAL damage of the source type. phys->fire 100%, fire->cold 100% with fire=500 originally
fire->cold with fire=0 originally is skipped (damage[idx]==0)
tags with several type bits: only the first match in order Phys,Light,Cold,Fire,Void,Necro,Poison is used (tags=Phys|Fire acts as Phys)
negative value moves damage backwards (target loses, source gains)
tags without a damage-type bit (Elemental 0x80, DoT 0x1000) never match -> no conversion

delayedDamage.fieldsAndSources: f7 comes from CharacterMutator.slowDamagePercentFromRareAndBossHits(0x1B34, PP 498), slowDamagePercentFromHits(0x1B38, PP 564), slowDamagePercentFromSpiritPlaguedHits(0x1B3C, PP 671); see condition "delayedDamage".
delayedDamage.f7Formula: x = (attacker is rare/boss and pp498!=0) ? (1-pp498) : 1; if pp671!=0 and attacker has SpiritPlague(59): x *= (1-pp671); f7 = 1 - (1-pp564)*x. Evaluated only for hits (isHit) with an attacker.
delayedDamage.immediatePart: ApplyDamage: M = f0; if f7>0: M = max(0, (1-f7)*M). The immediate part is the normal pipeline with this reduced multiplier (so armour, resist, block, endurance, ward all apply to the immediate part).
delayedDamage.delayedPart: After the health/ward step, if f7>0 AND damage D>0 AND the target survived (currentHealth>0) AND the target has a LeechTracker: LeechTracker.slowDamageInstances.Add(SlowDamageInstance{ totalDamage = remainingDamage = D/(1-f7)*f7, remainingDuration = 4.0 s (0x40800000), damage type = lethal-damage-properties of the hit, damageSource }). D is the damage value at the ward stage after armour/resist/block/damageTakenBuff/mana-before-ward/endurance-Everything/minimum-health, reduced by the endurance-threshold absorption (if applied) but NOT by ward or mana-before-health absorption.
delayedDamage.tick: LeechTracker.OnUpdateTick @0x18111C3F0: per frame each instance pays remaining*dt/remainingDuration (linear); the paid amount is applied with ProtectionClass.SurvivesDirectDamage(amount, hitEvent=false, out, applyUntagged=false): the untaggedDamageTakenModifier (SP6 untagged) is only used for the invulnerability test (<= -1 skips), the value is NOT scaled; minimumHealth (0x210/0x214) caps it; ward absorbs first (ward is consumed, wardGainModifier<0 branch for negative ward), the rest goes to BaseHealth.HealthDamage (boss ward TryGainBossWard in between). dotsBypassWard/hitsBypassWard are NOT consulted.
delayedDamage.mitigatedAgain: No. Armour, resistances, block, glancing, endurance, mana-before-health are applied only once (at hit time, shared proportionally with the immediate part). The delayed ticks bypass them; ward still absorbs ticks.
delayedDamage.relatedReaders: LeechTracker.GetSlowDamageRemaining feeds f8 (PP 525: extra endurance when delayed damage > 10% max health). BuffParent / DeathSealMutator call ClearRemainingSlowDamagePercent to cancel part of it.

leech.accrual: ProtectionClass.ApplyDamage (victim side) accumulates leechAmount after each damage type i has been fully mitigated (d = after resist, DamageTaken, DR, nearby, glancing, moving, armour): if attacker.ProtectionClass.hasLeechStats(0x178) is false: leechAmount += d * ProtectionClass.additionalLeech(0x1D4); else leechAmount += d * 0.1 * Stats.GetStatValueForHitEvents(attacker.stats, HealthLeech(SP51), tags=(otherTags with low byte = type tag i), hitEvents, added=10*additionalLeech, increased=0, more=0, extraTag=attacker primary AbilityID index, treatExtraTagZeroAsMatching=true).
leech.formulaPerType: leech_i = d_i * 0.1 * (10*additionalLeech + SumAdded(HealthLeech matching)) * (1 + SumIncreased) * Prod(1+more)   [= d_i * (additionalLeech + 0.1*SumAdded) when no increased/more]
leech.additionalLeech: ProtectionClass.additionalLeech(0x1D4) = DamageStats.additionalLeech(+0x40) + (victim is a player actor(+0x1CD) ? DamageStats.leechVsPlayers(+0x44) : 0)
leech.scale: CONFIRMED x0.1: the constant is 0x184561DB8 = 0.1 (readconst) in ISIL line 1357 and the base passed in is additionalLeech*10 (0x184561DDC = 10.0), so ability leech is 1:1 and the HealthLeech stat counts 0.1 per point. Data check: unique tooltip "3% of melee damage leeched as health" has HealthLeech value 0.3; Immortal Vise 0.1-0.2 = 1-2%; affix "Melee Health Leech" T1 0.23-0.29 = 2.3-2.9%. So a stat value v means v*10 percent of damage dealt.
leech.afterAccrual: (1) block/damageTakenBuff: leech *= D_after/D_before (ApplyDamage step 9, only if they differ); (2) after BaseHealth.HealthDamage returns the overkill amount: leech *= (D - overkill)/D where D is the total damage including the part absorbed by ward; (3) overkill leech: if isHit and overkill>0 and attacker.overkillLeech(PrecalculatedStatsHolder+0xF0, SP93)>0: leech += overkill*overkillLeech*0.1; (4) conditions: attacker != victim, attacker not dying, leech>0; then attacker.LeechTracker (created on demand) .AddLifeLeech(leech) (virtual; PlayerLeechTracker override).
leech.capByTargetHealth: Yes: only the share of D that is not overkill leeches (leech *= (D-overkill)/D). Ward-absorbed damage still leeches (D includes ward). No other cap.
leech.payout: LeechTracker.AddLifeLeech: ignored while the leech-disabled timer(0xBC)>0; otherwise appends leech and a duration 3/(1+IncreasedLeechRate(BaseStats+0xF8, SP102)) s; OnUpdateTick pays linearly; PlayerLeechTracker (player) can instead convert leech to damage of the nearest enemy within 6 m when CharacterMutator.leechDamagesEnemiesInstead(0x658) (PP/tree) or add percentLeechAlsoDealtAsDamage(0x1EB4, PP 599). The heal is a plain addition to BaseHealth.currentHealth with caps (ApplyLeechTick, same body as restoreHealth).
leech.increasedHealing: SP44 IncreasedHealing does NOT affect leech (LeechTracker/PlayerLeechTracker/ApplyLeechTick contain no SP44 read), nor HealthGain/ManaGain/WardGain on hit/crit/kill/block/stun/freeze (ResourceGainEvents calls BaseHealth.restoreHealth directly), nor health regen (BaseHealth.OnUpdateTick). SP44 readers found by exhaustive grep of Stats.Get*(..,0x2c,..): ability components that scale a heal (GiveSelfResourcesOnKill/OnAbilityUse, GiveCreatorResources*, GiveNearbyAlliesResourcesOnDeath, HealAlliesOnHit, HealParent, RepeatedlyHealAlliesWithinRadius, RepeatedlyGiveCreatorResources, CreateResourceReturnAbilityObject*; most gated by their bool healthScalesWithIncreasedHealing), skill mutators (Judgement uses BaseHealth.HealWithIncreasedHealingEffectiveness, ConsecratedGround, FlameTrail, EterrasBlessing, FuryLeap, RadiantLance, RingOfShields, RipBlood, Warcry, SummonRaptor, SummonVolatileZombie) and three CharacterMutator sites (potion/other heals, some with +0.04 per point of attribute 4). All are of the form heal*(1+SP44 value).

healthGainOnHit.storage: ResourceGainEvents.UpdateResourceGainTotals @0x18115B3A0 (runs on every BaseStats.updateStatsEvent): scans BaseStats.stats for SP38 HealthGain / SP39 WardGain / SP40 ManaGain stats with tags==0 AND extraTag==0 and sums their addedValue (ONLY added) by specialTag: 1=OnHit (stored in both the "on hit" slot 0x20/0x24/0x28 and the "on melee hit" slot 0x68/0x6C/0x70), 2=OnCrit(0x2C..), 3=OnKill(0x44..), 4=OnFreeze(0x50..), 5=OnStun(0x5C..), 6=OnBlock(0x38..), 7=OnMeleeHit only (0x68..). Stats with tags!=0 or extraTag!=0 (tagged/ability-specific, also minion-tagged) are handled by GainResourcesFromTaggedOrAbilitySpecificStats.
healthGainOnHit.application: AbilityEventListener.onHitEventDetailed -> GainResourcesOnHit(dae): if the detailed event is NOT a melee hit (dae.tags & 0x200 == 0): restoreHealth(healthOnHit), gainMana(manaOnHit), ProtectionClass.GainWard(wardOnHit); if melee: restoreHealth(healthOnMeleeHit), gainMana, GainWard(wardOnMeleeHit) (these include the specialTag-1 amount). OnKill/OnCrit/OnStun/OnFreeze/OnBlock analogous (GainResourcesOnKill @0x18115A1C0 ...). Block uses GainResourcesExceptWardOnBlock + GainWardOnBlock (own GainWard replica with moreWardGenerated). Tagged stats: per detailed event, each matching stat (CheckRegularTagsOnly, extraTag==0 or matches the ability index, event flag per specialTag, ICD via ResourceGainEvents.CanProc/ProcTimeTracker) adds its addedValue; the sum is applied once per event.
healthGainOnHit.perHit: per detailed ability hit event, i.e. per hit instance per enemy target; no division by number of hits; no scaling by IncreasedHealing, no scaling by any stat except what GainWard does for ward
healthGainOnHit.wardGain: ProtectionClass.GainWard(x) (06c 3.3): skipped if sourcesOfNoWardGain>=1; W += (1+t)*x where t = quirky combination of moreWardGeneratedValues; then wardGainModifier (from SP119 inc/more, 06c D?), then clamp to maxHealth*maxHealthCapForWard. No separate multiplier from SP39.
healthGainOnHit.healthGain: BaseHealth.restoreHealth(x): +x current health, capped at maxHealth, at BaseHealth healthCap (0xCA/0xCC) and at maxHealth*cap(0xA4) (e.g. Corrupted Form 50%); no scaling.
